part.text:
I couldn't complete the task. The simulator has no tap or touch input available through `simctl`, so I can't operate the app's UI.

What I did:
- Took screenshots and confirmed Bluesky is on the Following feed.
- Tried a deep link (`bluesky://search?q=test`) to get to search. It didn't navigate: it raised a system dialog, "Open in 'Bluesky'?", with Cancel and Open buttons. My attempt caused that dialog, and it is still on screen.

What's blocking it:
- Searching for "test" and switching to the People tab both need taps on the app's search field and tab bar. The available tools can only capture the screen, launch/terminate apps, and open URLs.
- The dialog can't be dismissed without a tap either. The Cancel or Open button would need one.

I didn't try workarounds such as injecting touch events through private simulator frameworks, since that goes around the input limits you described. If you can give me a way to send taps (for example, `idb`, or an XCUITest runner I can run against this simulator), I can finish the search and tab switch. Otherwise, the Bluesky app on the simulator is still showing the "Open in 'Bluesky'?" dialog, which whoever picks this up will need to dismiss first.
